decks.notes: This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures while controlling the board with spells like Disciple of Freyalise and Kozilek's Command. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with massive threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Emrakul, the Promised End while disrupting their plans with counterspells and removal spells. By combining ramp and control elements, this deck aims to dominate the late game and outmuscle the opponent with its powerful Eldrazi creatures.

The deck focuses on utilizing a mix of control spells and creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage. By combining a variety of removal spells, counterspells, and hand disruption alongside powerful threats like Quantum Riddler and Psychic Frog, the deck aims to control the game tempo and dominate the board state. The inclusion of Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides additional card draw and utility, while Subtlety and Harbinger of the Seas offer versatile answers to opposing threats. Overall, the deck emphasizes strategic decision-making and adaptability to outmaneuver and outplay opponents.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and put into play using Green Sun's Zenith and other creature tutors. The key strategy is to accelerate mana production with cards like Devoted Druid and Leyline of Abundance, then use that mana to cast powerful creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth and Shang-Chi, Master of Kung Fu to overwhelm the opponent quickly. Additionally, the deck includes disruption in the form of Endurance and Fiend Artisan to control the board and protect its own creatures.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using creatures like Devoted Druid and Vizier of Remedies to generate infinite mana, allowing for explosive plays with cards like Green Sun's Zenith to search for key creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth. The toolbox aspect of the deck comes from being able to search for specific creatures with cards like Duskwatch Recruiter and Fiend Artisan, while also having versatile options like Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler and Shang-Chi, Master of Kung Fu for additional creature-based interactions. The deck aims to quickly ramp up and overwhelm opponents with its strong creature synergies.

This deck aims to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Urza's Saga and Eldrazi Temple to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End. The key strategy is to generate tokens with Sowing Mycospawn and boost their power with Blade of the Bloodchief, Malevolent Rumble, and Boseiju, Who Endures. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Basking Broodscale and Devourer of Destiny to apply pressure on the opponent and control the board with removal spells like Dismember and Kozilek's Command. The ultimate goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of powerful creatures and disruptive spells.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and put into play using Green Sun's Zenith. By ramping up with Leyline of Abundance and Devoted Druid, the deck aims to generate mana quickly to play multiple creatures in one turn. The combo potential comes from cards like Vizier of Remedies and Walking Ballista, while also including support from cards like Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler and Nature's Rhythm. The deck's versatility and ability to generate explosive board states make it a strong contender in Modern 1 vs 1 play.

This deck focuses on quickly getting creatures into the graveyard and then reanimating them for powerful combos. Using cards like Goryo's Vengeance, Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and Griselbrand, the deck can quickly bring back powerful creatures to overwhelm opponents. Cards like Solitude and Teferi, Time Raveler provide protection and disruption, while Thoughtseize and Force of Negation help control the opponent's resources. The deck aims to take advantage of instant reanimation to create explosive plays and win the game in a single turn.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with low-cost creatures and burn spells. By combining aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler with efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, the deck aims to maintain board control and deal damage quickly. The inclusion of cantrips like Preordain and Mishra's Bauble helps keep card advantage and maintain consistency. The deck also includes utility lands like Fiery Islet and Arid Mesa to ensure smooth mana base. Overall, this deck is all about applying pressure early and finishing the game fast.

This Grixis Control deck focuses on card advantage and disruption to control the game. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card draw and filtering, while Psychic Frog and Quantum Riddler offer disruption and tempo plays. Unholy Heat and Fatal Push provide efficient removal, while Force of Negation and Spell Snare help to counter key spells. Consign to Memory and Dress Down offer versatility and disruption options. Kaito, Bane of Nightmares is a win condition that can close out games quickly. Overall, the deck aims to out-value and outlast opponents through careful resource management and disruption.

This deck focuses on aggressive play, utilizing a mix of cheap creatures and powerful spells to apply pressure early in the game. It seeks to take control of the board quickly and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creatures' abilities and direct damage, while also having some control elements to protect its threats. The deck aims to be proactive and efficient, using a blend of white, red, and blue cards to create a versatile and disruptive game plan that can adapt to different matchups.

The main concept of this Jeskai Aggro deck is to apply pressure on the opponent with a mix of creatures and spells, focusing on quick and efficient threats. With a strong mana base and versatile removal options like Prismatic Ending and Solitude, the deck can handle a variety of threats while maintaining a fast clock. Cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provide early aggression, while cards like Ephemerate and Voice of Victory offer added value and protection. The deck aims to close out games quickly while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a mix of cheap and efficient creatures, burn spells, and card advantage engines. By utilizing aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, backed up by efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart, the goal is to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The deck also features card selection spells like Preordain and Expressive Iteration, allowing the pilot to consistently find the tools they need to maintain pressure and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck aims to quickly reanimate powerful creatures, such as Griselbrand, using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Faithful Mending. Atraxa, Grand Unifier provides support and protection for the combo pieces. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation to control the game. Solitude and Teferi, Time Raveler can help deal with threats and provide additional value. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent and win the game before they have a chance to react.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively overwhelm the opponent with a combination of powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, along with efficient removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm. The deck also utilizes disruptive elements like Blood Moon and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also generating value with cards like Seasoned Pyromancer. The deck aims to apply constant pressure and tempo advantage to secure a fast victory in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to play aggressively and quickly with cheap creatures and spells to pressure the opponent early on. Cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler are key in this strategy, while also utilizing cards like Lava Dart and Lightning Bolt for removal and direct damage. The deck aims to win the game quickly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize, while also having some flexibility with card draw and potential creature buffs. The mana base is set up to ensure consistency in casting spells and maintaining a fast pace.

The deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with blink effects to disrupt the opponent's strategy and generate value. By using cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate to temporarily exile creatures and trigger their enters-the-battlefield effects multiple times, the deck can control the board while dealing damage quickly. The inclusion of cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Fatal Push provide additional disruption and removal options. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and blink effects to secure victory.
